necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome, corresponding to diagnosis codes I49.9 and I47.1. Due to the intermittent nature of these symptoms, mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) was medically necessary to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This diagnostic procedure is essential for accurate diagnosis and management of the patient's arrhythmic conditions.
